posts.headline: Put it in Ra is 0-2 and this column has now spent SIX editions documenting the collapse of a 20-8, 1.5-average-finish pedigree, and One Nut Barner still hasn't said a word.
posts.detail: League-best career winning percentage of .714 sitting at 0-2 with 238.06 points — that's not variance anymore, that's a full-blown identity crisis for a two-time runner-up franchise.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and this is officially the longest I've ever had to beg a league to pay attention to a juggernaut.
posts.detail: Triciagloston has led the league in scoring three straight editions I've covered, yet her middle-tier pedigree (6-7-1 career, 5th avg finish) means nobody's treating her like the best team in Busters Anonymous — my mistake is thinking that'll last.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0 for the reigning champs and I'm still not sold — 263.62 points through two weeks is survival football, not a coronation.
posts.detail: A title and a 14-14 career record means Tyrique14 gets zero benefit of the doubt from me; a defending champ grinding out wins instead of blowing teams out is exactly the crack in the armor contenders like this get punished for eventually.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is 1-1 and the untalented tenth's smoke machine is running out of fuel for good this time.
posts.detail: 215.08 points on the season backing up a 4-10, dead-last-average-finish résumé — the mirage I've been calling out for a week straight is finally matching the numbers.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-2 with a league-worst 165.84 points, and Auntie Thomas is proving the bottom-feeder tag was generous.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and 10th-place average finish set the bar low, and somehow this start is limboing right under it — softly-spoken struggles indeed.
